result.summary: Tail exclusion certified for 48 of 48 signed equations. Each complete list also uses the supplied inclusive bounded result E-4610da.
result.justification: For each successful record, exact norm, conjugate magnitude, dyadic angle enclosure, rational separation and tail inequalities instantiate the stated argument using the explicit Baker–Wüstholz theorem. UNKNOWN records make no exclusion.
result.sanity: Checked a non-axis solution, both signed inverse maps, axis rejection, pure cubic arithmetic, and a tail angle certificate for the field of the cube root of 7.
